2607.24471.title: Grounding latent algorithm routing in transformer reasoning
2607.24471.paper_summary: A central question in the in-context learning literature is whether transformers can organize episode-level adaptation around different inductive-bias families. We study this question in a controlled setting through latent algorithm routing: route-like behavior in which the solver-family preference changes with the latent data-generating regime while prompt form is held fixed, remains stable under nuisance perturbations, and is selectively influenced by targeted activation interventions without large losses in answer quality. We introduce ROUTEBENCH, a diagnostic benchmark whose regimes differentially favor global shrinkage, sparsity, robustness, and locality, operationalized by ridge-like, lasso-like, Huber-like, and kNN-like family representatives. Across dense decoder-only transformers trained from scratch at 44M-612M parameters, a 306M model closes 80.9 percent of the oracle-routing gap and achieves route F1 of 84.1. The effect remains substantial under natural-language renderings, shuffled supports, lexical paraphrases, and a unified four-way routing setting. Stronger adaptive alternatives, including an input-conditioned soft mixture and an unsupervised Gumbel router, narrow the gap but remain below the 306M and 612M models on route F1 and OOD performance. Probe controls and matched activation-patching controls further show that route-relevant internal directions are decodable and functionally involved in solver-family-consistent output behavior. These results provide controlled evidence that dense transformers trained on ROUTEBENCH can develop route-like internal variables, but they do not establish universal routing in pretrained language models or unrestricted natural-language reasoning.
2607.24471.paper_summary_zh: 一個在上下文學習文獻中的核心問題是，Transformer是否能夠圍繞不同的歸納偏差家族組織情節級適應。我們通過潛在算法路由在一個受控環境中研究這個問題：一種路由類行為，其中解決者家族的偏好隨著潛在數據生成機制的變化而改變，同時提示形式保持固定，並在干擾擾動下保持穩定，且受到有針對性的激活干預的選擇性影響，而不會在答案質量上造成大損失。我們引入了ROUTEBENCH，一個診斷基準，其機制在全局收縮、稀疏性、穩健性和局部性方面有不同的偏好，這些由類似脊的、類似套索的、類似Huber的和類似kNN的家族代表來操作。在從零開始訓練的44M-612M參數的稠密解碼器Transformer中，306M模型縮小了80.9%的神諭路由差距，並達到了84.1的路由F1。這一效果在自然語言渲染、隨機支持、詞彙改寫和統一的四路路由設置下仍然顯著。更強的自適應替代方案，包括基於輸入的軟混合和無監督的Gumbel路由器，縮小了差距，但在路由F1和OOD性能上仍低於306M和612M模型。探測控制和匹配的激活修補控制進一步顯示，與路由相關的內部方向是可解碼的，並在解決者家族一致的輸出行為中發揮功能。這些結果提供了受控證據，表明在ROUTEBENCH上訓練的稠密Transformer可以發展出類似路由的內部變量，但並未確立預訓練語言模型或不受限制的自然語言推理中的普遍路由。
